title: Editor randomly crashes at start when using Wayland.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.dev [c71c2bfc5]

### System information

Fedora Kinoite 43 GNU/Linux - Wayland

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

Open a project while the `run/platforms/linuxbsd/prefer_wayland` setting is enabled.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Unnecessary.
